subject: PolyForge APAC — GST routing, e-invoice aliasing & PO entity decision
messages:
From: Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@polyforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@polyforge.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 17:14:00 +08:00
Subject: GST registration and invoice format for APAC PO

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call earlier. We need to confirm two things so we can accept POs from Redwood and issue tax-compliant invoices in Singapore/Malaysia region: 

1) Which Redwood legal entity will be the billing party for APAC POs (Redwood Singapore Pte Ltd or Redwood International Ltd)? This affects whether we should charge Singapore GST or follow reverse-charge.

2) Does Redwood accept e-invoice XML aliasing (your system supports an aliasing header so our local e-invoice can map to one Redwood entity while the PO is created under a different internal cost center)? We've attached a sample e-invoice XML and our GST registration (polyforge_gst_certificate.pdf, sample_einvoice_2026_08.xml).

If you can confirm the entity and the preferred invoice fields (VAT/GST number field name, invoice recipient entity name, and whether you require PO line-level tax amounts), we will prepare a test invoice to validate in your APAC payables flow.

Regards,
Sana Iqbal
Head of Finance Operations, PolyForge APAC
attachments: polyforge_gst_certificate.pdf (pdf), sample_einvoice_2026_08.xml (xml)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@polyforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 20:03:00 +11:00
Subject: Re: GST registration and invoice format for APAC PO

Hi Sana — thanks for the docs and the sample XML. Quick answers to unblock you: 

- Billing entity: For now we typically route customer-facing APAC POs to "Redwood International Ltd" (our non-resident APAC billing entity) unless the customer explicitly requires Singapore entity invoicing. For vendor payments, Finance prefers to receive invoices addressed to "Redwood Singapore Pte Ltd" when the PO was raised by the SG legal entity. Can you confirm whether the PO you'll receive will show Redwood Singapore Pte Ltd as the recipient? If not, we'll route your PO to Redwood International Ltd and flag for tax review.

- E-invoice aliasing: We can accept an alias header (x-rw-einvoice-alias) in our APAC ingestion pipeline; we'll need the mapping table (alias -> legal entity) during testing. The sample XML looks fine but we need the GST field to be in the <TaxRegistrationNumber> node (your sample uses TaxRegNo which we can map, but ask you to include the standard node in the test payload).

Ben and Laura — looping you in to confirm tax treatment (GST vs reverse-charge) and whether we require line-level tax. Sana — can you provide a test invoice with PO number and indicate whether PolyForge will GST-charge or expect reverse-charge treatment?

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@polyforge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:21:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: GST registration and invoice format for APAC PO

Hi all — quick tax notes from my side after reviewing the GST cert: 

- PolyForge GST cert appears valid for SG. If the invoice is billed to Redwood Singapore Pte Ltd, we will accept GST-inclusive invoices and claim the input tax where applicable. 

- If invoiced to Redwood International Ltd (outside SG), then the invoice should be zero-rated and we need an explicit reverse-charge declaration in the invoice body plus PolyForge's GST registration number. For Malaysia, similar rules apply but the registration numbers and invoice text differ. 

- Line-level tax: Finance prefers line-level tax details for correct PO matching and cost-allocation across GL codes. If you can't supply that, we can accept a summary tax line but it'll require manual matching, which delays payment.

Laura — can you confirm operationally which billing entity we should request for PolyForge?

Ben
Director, Global Tax & Procurement, Redwood Inference

From: Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@polyforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@polyforge.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:02:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: GST registration and invoice format for APAC PO

Thanks Ben — that's clear and helpful. We will: 

- Send a test invoice addressed to "Redwood Singapore Pte Ltd" showing GST charged (since your PO will show SG entity). Test invoice will include line-level tax.
- Include TaxRegistrationNumber node in the XML and add x-rw-einvoice-alias = "RW-SG" in the alias header. We'll also add a reverse-charge note when the PO is assigned to non-SG entity.

Attaching the test invoice and GST evidence now. Please confirm when you can ingest the test payload so we can complete vendor activation.

Regards,
Sana
attachments: polyforge_test_invoice_2026-08-24.pdf (pdf), sample_einvoice_2026_08.xml (xml)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@polyforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GST registration and invoice format for APAC PO

Sana — confirmed, we received the test invoice and the XML. Laura and I validated the alias header mapping (RW-SG -> Redwood Singapore Pte Ltd) in our staging ingestion. A couple of operational notes before we flip to production: 

- Please ensure the PO number you populate is the Redwood system PO (starts RW-APAC-...). Our payables ingestion will reject invoices without that PO string in the <OrderReference> node.
- For multi-country shipments, include the country code in the invoice line (ISO2) so Finance can auto-assign VAT/GST treatment.
- We'll keep the vendor record as "PolyForge Technologies (APAC)" with primary remit to the Singapore bank details you provided. Any change in remit entity will require a 7-business-day revalidation from Finance.

Ben — if you're good with the alias mapping and line-level tax requirement, I'll mark this vendor live for APAC POs and request procurement to issue the first test PO (RW-APAC-4721).

Sana — thanks for the fast turnaround. Laura will send the vendor activation confirmation once PO is issued.

Best,
Marcus
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
